shared_or_similar_visual_information: Circular marker at the edge of a marked interval or at a point on a plotted trace. Compare the right-hand mark at t=4√6/3 on the left with the mark at −2 on the number line on the right.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: The displayed function has no value at t=4√6/3. Right image: The displayed set excludes −2 at its upper bound.
Rationales: On the left, the hollow marker omits the indicated point and there is no other plotted value at t=4√6/3. On the right, the hollow endpoint marks a strict boundary of the marked ray.
